source.title: Cell therapy for chronic TBI: Interim analysis of the randomized controlled STEMTRA trial

scope: Author-reported phase 2 trial, adult chronic focal motor TBI; not a hippocampal neuron birth study.
endpoint: Fugl–Meyer Motor Scale change at 24 weeks / 6 months
secondary_outcomes: No statistically significant between-group differences on secondary efficacy endpoints.
reproduction: Reported values transcribed; review did not reanalyse participant data.

followup48.scope: Reported values only; not independently reanalysed; not a separate trial.
